what: The start list of the record book (node/book.mjs, since 3.76): product pages the sea checks first every day, before its other watched pages. Stores whose commission programmes the sea applied for, and goods people ask for most around Black Friday; a store's own /products/<handle> page, at most 2 per store, never Amazon. The page checked never carries a commission; a commission can only come from another store that appears as an offer. A page that gives no comparison on 2 days in a row rests 30 days.
